metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the complete Rust LAS 1.4 inspector/renderer in [output](/workspace/output).

Key files:

- [Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml)
- [main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs)
- [las.rs](/workspace/output/src/las.rs)
- [json.rs](/workspace/output/src/json.rs)
- [base64.rs](/workspace/output/src/base64.rs)

The project uses only the Rust standard library and has an empty dependency table. It supports all requested point formats, structured VLR/EVLR records, CRS validation, waveform data, Extra Bytes metadata, strict LAS validation, JSON responses, and required exit codes.

Verified with:

```bash
cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml
```

Round-trip tests covered legacy GeoTIFF data, WKT, point format 10, waveform EVLRs, classification lookup records, typed Extra Bytes, and opaque/superseded records.

editorial.last_message: Completed the Rust LAS implementation; unchanged source scores 223/223 under LAS 2.0.5. All tests pass. Release build and local roundtrips are corroborated; Cargo ran zero unit tests and external interoperability is unverified.
editorial.notes:
Tests-only LAS 2.0.5 regrade of the unchanged preserved gpt-5.6-sol Max Rust source. The previous 2.0.4 publication scored 219/223; the corrected suite scores 223/223 with no skips or errors. All 219 unaffected node identities and outcomes are identical, and the four renamed zero-waveform cases pass. Their fixtures now retain valid file-level descriptors and storage, changing only the point's waveform association. Descriptor index zero is a per-point absence marker and does not unambiguously waive separately required file metadata. Any previous classification of metadata/storage-free zero-waveform rejection as a proven model defect is withdrawn. The old publication and prior audit chain are preserved in full. No failures remain in this suite; this is not a claim of exhaustive LAS standard conformance. The original completion, source/transcript and accounting reviews remain applicable to the unchanged generation; their full historical editorial text remains in the linked prior publication. Root and an independent reviewer checked the revised public-contract interpretation, focused reference/mutation controls, source preservation and per-case comparison. Release build and local roundtrips are corroborated; Cargo ran zero unit tests and external interoperability is unverified. Original raw result/source hashes, generation metadata, input/output/cache/reasoning token totals and recorded cost are retained. Current usage is independently reparsed from preserved events. The regrade makes no new model calls and adds no generation cost. Reasoning remains an output subset. Any separate tool-count recovery is explicitly linked and preserves its historical evidence.

Run conditions: apps explicitly disabled in the recorded launch; no external tool invocation observed.
